note: Problem playbook: known failures, their likely cause, the safe fix and who decides. The cycle attaches the matching entry to a failed or degraded step, its escalation and the console. 'agents' means the system may retry or repair itself; 'owner' means only the owner may act (money, limits, sources, data confirmations).

problems.cause: The API is not running (stopped, crashed, or a migration failed on start).
problems.fix: Start it with npm start (take a backup first if a new migration will apply); read its console for a migration error.

problems.text: previous data kept|large move kept back
problems.cause: The data steward refused a download: a move over 20% in a day, a history rewrite or a shorter history.
problems.fix: Check the news for the named day; if the move is real, confirm it once with daily.py accept-move --symbol <S> --date <D>, then rerun the cycle.

problems.cause: The whole past was rescaled: most likely a split or bonus.
problems.fix: Read the exchange notice and record the action (POST /v1/corporate-actions) so paper positions are rescaled.

problems.cause: Yahoo could not be reached or answered with an error.
problems.fix: The step retries itself; if it keeps failing, check the network and rerun later. Prices stay at the last accepted day meanwhile.

problems.cause: A publisher feed failed (network, a changed address, a blocked reader or malformed XML) or is backing off after failures.
problems.fix: The feed backs off by itself; if it stays failing, run npm run world -- coverage and enable the backup it names, or probe the feed again.

problems.cause: A bot's code changed after its release was authorised, so it may not trade.
problems.fix: The release-renewal step prepares a new release from the changed code; with trials allowed by the standing approvals it starts as a canary, otherwise approve it on the agenda.

problems.cause: The department used today's model allowance.
problems.fix: Nothing to do: the step runs tomorrow. Raise the allowance (POST /v1/compute/allowance) only if the work is worth it.

problems.cause: The local model is off or did not answer completely.
problems.fix: Set MODEL_AUTOSTART in .env so the supervisor starts it, or start it and run the cycle with --with-model; an incomplete answer is retried next cycle.

problems.cause: An earlier step has not produced this step's input yet (first days, or an upstream step failed).
problems.fix: Fix the upstream step; this one runs by itself once its input exists.

problems.cause: The step ran past its time limit (slow model, slow network or a large backlog). On a laptop CPU (about 5 tokens a second) R&D invention's long prompt can pass its 240-second limit.
problems.fix: Rerun the cycle: finished steps are skipped. If it repeats, the backlog or the model speed is the problem.
Read the step's summary in .local/cycles/<day>.json, rerun the cycle once, and if it repeats record the cause here.
